reviews.text: Best food truck tacos in Silver Spring! The al pastor is incredible, perfectly marinated with a nice char. Salsa verde is legit spicy. Only downside is the wait can be 20+ minutes on weekends.
Decent tacos but nothing special. The carne asada was a bit dry. Portions are generous though and the staff is super friendly. Would come back to try other items.
Trippy Tacos is a vibe. The birria tacos are hands down the best I've had in MoCo. The consomme for dipping is rich and flavorful. They also have great horchata. 10/10 recommend.
Went for lunch on a Tuesday, barely any wait. Fish tacos were fresh and crispy. The mango habanero sauce is fire. Prices are reasonable for the quality. Will definitely be a regular.
Ordered the trippy combo and it was way too much food lol. Everything tasted great though. The elote is a must-try. My only complaint is they ran out of the churros before I could order.
